crossRefs.note: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.
Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.
We traveled from Horeb and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw, by the way to the hill…
The thing pleased me well. I took twelve of your men, one man for every tribe.
When Yahweh sent you from Kadesh Barnea, saying, “Go up and possess the land which I have given you,” you rebelled…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

people.name: Paran
people.line: A desert region in the Sinai Peninsula

translations.web: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of Yahweh. All of them were men who were heads of the children of Israel.
translations.bsb: So at the command of the LORD, Moses sent them out from the Wilderness of Paran. All the men were leaders of the Israelites,
translations.kjv: And Moses by the commandment of the LORD sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Israel.
translations.asv: And Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of Jehovah: all of them men who were heads of the children of Israel.
